主要内容: HENRY SCHEIN, INC approved the 2015 compensation paid to its Named Executive Officers, known as the 'say-on-pay' proposal, by non-binding vote. The vote results were: For 63,408,834, Against 3,283,223, Abstain 2,724,970, Broker Non-Votes 5,956,941. The selection of BDO USA, LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2016 was also ratified with votes: For 74,890,226, Against 436,920, Abstain 46,822.
